<USER_REQUEST>
Create the main HTML file at d:\trading\web\index.html for an Indian Stock Trading Signal Dashboard. 

Include these in <head>:
- Google Font: Inter (300,400,500,600,700)
- Chart.js from CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- Link to style.css
- Proper meta tags, title: 'TradeSignal Pro - Indian Stock Trading Signals'
- Favicon emoji: chart_with_upwards_trend

Structure:

1. **Sidebar** (class='sidebar'):
   - Logo: 'TradeSignal Pro' with a chart icon
   - Navigation tabs: Scanner | Backtest | Live Test
   - Stock input: text input with id='stockInput' and placeholder 'Enter stock (e.g., RELIANCE)'
   - Quick add buttons: RELIANCE, TCS, INFY, HDFCBANK, SBIN (small chips that add to input)
   - Strategy selector section with heading 'Classic Strategies':
     - Checkboxes for: ema_crossover, rsi_reversion, macd_momentum, supertrend, bollinger_breakout, combo, vwap_ema
   - Strategy selector section with heading 'ICT Strategies':
     - Checkboxes for: ict_fvg, ict_orderblock, ict_liquidity, ict_ote
   - Select All / Deselect All buttons
   - Timeframe selector: Intraday (15m) | Swing (1d) | Positional (1wk)
   - Period selector: 3 months | 6 months | 1 year | 2 years
   - Capital input: number input, default 100000
   - Run button: big green button 'Run Analysis' with id='runBtn'

2. **Main Content** (class='main-content'):
   
   a. **Scanner View** (id='scannerView'):
      - Header: 'Signal Scanner' with scan count
      - Progress bar (id='scanProgress')
      - Signal summary cards row: Total Scanned, Buy Signals, Sell Signals, Hold
      - Results table (id='scanResults') with columns: Stock, Price, Change%, Signal, Score, Entry, SL, Target, R:R, RSI
      - Each row should have data attributes for filtering
   
   b. **Backtest View** (id='backtestView', initially hidden):
      - Header: 'Strategy Backtester'
      - Comparison table (id='compareTable')
      - Detailed report section (id='detailReport'):
        - Performance metrics cards: Total Return, Win Rate, Profit Factor, Sharpe Ratio, Max Drawdown, R:R Ratio
        - Chart canvas (id='equityChart') for equity curve
        - Chart canvas (id='pnlChart') for P&L distribution
        - Trade log table (id='tradeLog')
   
   c. **Live Test View** (id='liveView', initially hidden):
      - Header: 'Paper Trading'
      - Portfolio summary cards: Capital, Unrealized P&L, Total Return, Open Positions
      - Open positions table (id='openPositions')
      - Closed trades table (id='closedTrades')
      - Status/log area (id='liveLog')

3. **Toast container** (id='toastContainer') - for notifications

4. **Modal** (id='detailModal') - for detailed single stock analysis

5. **Disclaimer bar** at very bottom: 'For educational purposes only. Not financial advice.'

6. **Script tag**: link to app.js

Use semantic HTML5, unique IDs for all interactive elements. Keep it clean and well-structured.
</USER_REQUEST>
<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>
The current local time is: 2026-05-24T20:58:01+05:30.
</ADDITIONAL_METADATA>
